expected_evidence_per_group.A-reads: Read-only tests; no production data path changes.
expected_evidence_per_group.A-2: Write path tests; rollback procedure documented.
expected_evidence_per_group.C: Significant refactor tests; cross-module integration tests.

hard_stop_conditions: Any must-pin item is broken or fails the pin test. The PR is blocked. The B-track governance refresh is required.
Any structural guardrail (G1-G6) is broken or fails the enforcement test. The PR is blocked. The B-track governance refresh is required.
Any behavior guardrail test fails. The PR is blocked. The rollback procedure is invoked.
The Phase 53 refactor order is violated. The PR is blocked. Agent B escalates to the user.
Agent B is not notified of the PR. The B-track governance refresh may be skipped. Agent B is subsequently informed.
The Phase 53 PR is merged with a non-passing check. The PR is rolled back if possible. The B-track governance refresh is required.

do_not_parallelize_areas.rationale: Affects the production data path. Review required.
The persistence layer migration is not parallel-safe. The migration is performed by Agent A in a single coordinated step.

pilot_impact_per_group.A-2: High. Affects the production data path. Pilot surface area may change. Pin refresh or forward-compatibility decision may be required.
pilot_impact_per_group.C: High. Significant refactor. Pilot surface area may change. Pin refresh required.
pilot_impact_per_group.B: Highest. Highest blast radius. Pilot surface area will change. Pin refresh required.

external_review_impact_per_group.A-2: Medium. The B3 matrix, B12 heatmap, and B16 closeout tracker may need a refresh.
external_review_impact_per_group.C: High. The B3 matrix, B12 heatmap, and B16 closeout tracker need a refresh.
external_review_impact_per_group.B: Highest. The B3 matrix, B12 heatmap, B16 closeout tracker, and B8 enterprise SaaS readiness tracker may need a refresh.

paid_pilot_gate_impact_per_group.A-2: Medium. The B13 paid pilot gate may need a refresh.
paid_pilot_gate_impact_per_group.C: High. The B13 paid pilot gate needs a refresh.
paid_pilot_gate_impact_per_group.B: Highest. The B13 paid pilot gate needs a refresh.

b_track_refresh_trigger_per_group.A-2: B3 matrix, B12 heatmap, B13 gate, B16 closeout, B26 must-pin tracker refresh.
b_track_refresh_trigger_per_group.C: B3 matrix, B12 heatmap, B13 gate, B16 closeout, B26 must-pin tracker, B27 guardrail adoption tracker refresh.

global_notes: Agent B does not implement Phase 53. Agent A executes Phase 53.
Agent B does not modify repository.py, app/persistence, app/services, main_web.py, or any Agent A-owned file. The risk and gate matrix is the B-track governance wrapper for the Agent A code work.
The risk and gate matrix is internal planning, not external validation, not a customer reference, not production readiness, and not paid pilot authorization.

The auto-merge policy is a documented governance expectation. Branch protection rules on main, if configured, enforce the policy technically. If branch protection is not configured, the policy is a soft expectation.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
